Which quote is cheaper, and by how much?

The **[Small deductible plan](/lightning/r/0Q0aj000003aaHmCAI/view)** is cheaper by **$10,465** a year (about 7%). In exchange, it carries a $2,500 deductible.

| Quote | Annual premium | Deductible | Limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Small deductible plan](/lightning/r/0Q0aj000003aaHmCAI/view) | **$139,035** | $2,500 | $1,000,000 |
| [Guaranteed cost](/lightning/r/0Q0aj000003aaHlCAI/view) | **$149,500** | $0 | $1,000,000 |

The customer has both quotes, and they're valid until Oct 20. [Option 3](/lightning/r/0Q0aj000003aaODCAY/view) isn't included because it's still a draft with no premium.
